en.s: Emperor Zhuangzong of Later Tang (Chinese: 後唐莊宗), personal name Li Cunxu (Chinese: 李存朂 or 李存勗 or 李存勖; pinyin: Lǐ Cúnxù), nickname Yazi (亞子), stage name Li Tianxia (李天下), was the second ruling prince of the Former Jin dynasty (r. 908–923) who later became the founding emperor of the Later Tang dynasty (r. 923–926) during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period of Chinese history.

zh.s: 后唐庄宗李存勖（中文名：後唐莊宗；又写作李存朂、李存勗或李存勖，拼音：Lǐ Cúnxù），小名亚子，艺名李天下。五代十国时期，他于908年至923年间担任前晋的第二位统治者，之后成为后唐开国皇帝（923年至926年在位）。

en.s: The siege of Beirut in 1110 occurred in the aftermath of the First Crusade. The coastal city of Beirut was captured from the Fatimids by the forces of Baldwin I of Jerusalem on 13 May 1110, with the assistance of Bertrand of Toulouse and a Genoese fleet.

zh.s: 1110年第一次十字军东征后，贝鲁特遭到围攻。耶路撒冷国王鲍德温一世率军在图卢兹的贝特朗和热那亚舰队协助下，于1110年5月13日从法蒂玛王朝手中攻占这座沿海城市。

en.t: Julian of Norwich has visions of Jesus while suffering from a life-threatening illness, visions which are later described and interpreted in her book Revelations of Divine Love
en.s: Julian of Norwich (c. 1343 – after 1416), also known as Juliana of Norwich, the Lady Julian, Dame Julian or Mother Julian, was a medieval English Catholic anchoress. Her writings, now known as Revelations of Divine Love, are the earliest surviving English-language works attributed to a woman. They are also the only surviving English-language works by an anchoress.

zh.t: 诺里奇的朱利安患上危及生命的重病期间见到耶稣异象，后来在《神圣之爱的启示》中记录并阐释
zh.s: 诺里奇的朱利安（约1343年—1416年后），也称诺里奇的朱莉安娜、朱利安夫人、朱利安女士或朱利安修女，是中世纪英格兰天主教隐修女。她的著作现称《神圣之爱的启示》，是现存最早可确认由女性创作的英语作品，也是现存唯一由隐修女创作的英语作品。

en.s: The Battle of Langside, fought on 13 May 1568, was one of the more unusual contests in Scottish history, bearing a superficial resemblance to a grand family quarrel, in which a woman fought her brother who was defending the rights of her infant son. In 1567 Mary, Queen of Scots' short period of personal rule ended in recrimination, intrigue and disaster when, after her capture at Carberry Hill, she was forced to abdicate in favour of James VI, her infant son. Mary was imprisoned in Loch Leven Castle, while her Protestant half-brother, James Stewart, Earl of Moray was appointed Regent on behalf of his nephew.

zh.s: 兰赛德战役于1568年5月13日发生，是苏格兰历史上较为特别的一场冲突，表面上很像一场家族纷争：一名女子与她的兄弟交战，而兄弟正维护她年幼儿子的权利。1567年，苏格兰女王玛丽短暂的亲政时期以互相指责、阴谋和灾难告终。她在卡伯里山被捕后，被迫退位，让位给年幼的儿子詹姆斯六世。玛丽被囚禁在洛赫利文城堡，她信奉新教的同父异母兄长、莫里伯爵詹姆斯·斯图亚特则被任命为摄政王，代表外甥执政。

en.t: Dutch statesman Johan van Oldenbarnevelt is executed in The Hague after being convicted of treason
en.s: Johan van Oldenbarnevelt (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈjoːɦɑɱ vɑn ɔldə(m)ˈbɑrnəvɛlt]; 14 September 1547 – 13 May 1619), Heer van Berkel en Rodenrijs (1600), Gunterstein (1611) and Bakkum (1613), was a Dutch statesman and revolutionary who played an important role in the Dutch struggle for independence from Spain. Van Oldenbarnevelt was born in Amersfoort. He studied law at the universities of Leuven, Bourges, Heidelberg, and Padua, and traveled in France and Italy before settling permanently in The Hague.

zh.t: 荷兰政治家约翰·范·奥尔登巴内费尔特因叛国罪被判有罪后在海牙处决
zh.s: 约翰·范·奥尔登巴内费尔特（1547 年 9 月 14 日—1619 年 5 月 13 日）是荷兰政治家和革命者，在荷兰摆脱西班牙统治的斗争中发挥了重要作用。他曾获贝尔克尔恩罗登赖斯（1600 年）、洪特斯泰因（1611 年）和巴克姆（1613 年）领主头衔。他出生于阿默斯福特，先后在鲁汶、布尔日、海德堡和帕多瓦的大学学习法律，并在定居海牙前游历法国和意大利。

en.s: The Battle of Surabaya was fought in May 1677 during the Trunajaya rebellion, in which the Dutch East India Company (known by its Dutch acronym "VOC") defeated the forces of Trunajaya and took Surabaya on behalf of its ally, the Mataram Sultanate.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 泗水战役发生于1677年5月，是特鲁纳贾亚叛乱期间的一场战役。荷兰东印度公司（简称VOC）击败特鲁纳贾亚的部队，并代表其盟友马打兰苏丹国占领泗水。

en.s: The Raid on Dartmouth (also referred to as the Dartmouth Massacre) occurred during Father Le Loutre’s War on May 13, 1751 when a Mi’kmaq and Acadia militia from Chignecto, under the command of Acadian Joseph Broussard, raided Dartmouth, Nova Scotia, destroying the town and killing twenty British villagers and wounding British regulars. The town was protected by a blockhouse on Blackburn Hill with William Clapham's Rangers and British regulars from the 45th Regiment of Foot. This raid was one of seven the Natives and Acadians would conduct against the town during the war.

zh.s: 1751年5月13日，达特茅斯突袭（又称达特茅斯大屠杀）发生于勒卢特尔神父战争期间。来自希涅克托的米克马克人和阿卡迪亚民兵在阿卡迪亚人约瑟夫·布萨尔指挥下袭击新斯科舍省达特茅斯，摧毁城镇，杀死20名英国居民，并打伤英国正规军。当地在布莱克本山的碉堡由威廉·克拉潘的游骑兵和英国第45步兵团正规军守卫。这场突袭是战争期间原住民和阿卡迪亚人对该镇发动的七次袭击之一。

en.s: The Treaty of Teschen (German: Frieden von Teschen, lit. 'Peace of Teschen'; French: Traité de Teschen) was signed on 13 May 1779 in Teschen, then in Austrian Silesia, between the Austrian Habsburg monarchy and the Kingdom of Prussia, which officially ended the War of the Bavarian Succession.

zh.s: 泰申条约（德语：Frieden von Teschen，意为“泰申和平”；法语：Traité de Teschen）于1779年5月13日在泰申签署。当时泰申属于奥属西里西亚，签约双方为奥地利哈布斯堡君主国和普鲁士王国。条约正式结束了巴伐利亚王位继承战争。

en.s: The action of 13 May 1779 was a battle in Cancale Bay, near St Malo, between French and British squadrons. The French force had been part of the escort meant for Karl Heinrich von Nassau-Siegen's invasion of Jersey. When that invasion failed on 1 May the French retreated to Coutances.

zh.s: 1779年5月13日，法、英两国舰队在圣马洛附近的坎卡勒湾交战。法军原本负责护送卡尔·海因里希·冯·拿骚-齐根入侵泽西岛。入侵于5月1日失败后，法军撤退至库唐斯。

en.s: The War of the Bavarian Succession (German: Bayerischer Erbfolgekrieg; 3 July 1778 – 13 May 1779) was a dispute between the Austrian Habsburg monarchy and an alliance of Saxony and Prussia over succession to the Electorate of Bavaria after the extinction of the Bavarian branch of the House of Wittelsbach. The Habsburgs sought to acquire Bavaria, and the alliance opposed them, favoring another branch of the Wittelsbachs.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 巴伐利亚王位继承战争
zh.s: 巴伐利亚王位继承战争（德语：Bayerischer Erbfolgekrieg；1778年7月3日至1779年5月13日）源于巴伐利亚维特尔斯巴赫家族支系断绝后，奥地利哈布斯堡君主国与萨克森、普鲁士联盟之间的继承权争端。哈布斯堡家族试图取得巴伐利亚，萨克森和普鲁士则支持维特尔斯巴赫家族的另一支系。
zh.n: 本条记录采用资料框中给出的事件结束日期。

en.t: The Cumberland Compact is signed by leaders of the settlers in the Cumberland River area of what would become the U.S. state of Tennessee, providing for democratic government and a formal system of justice
en.s: The Cumberland Compact was signed at a Longhunter and native American trading post and camp near the French Lick aka the "Big Salt Springs" on the Cumberland River on May 13, 1780, by 256 settlers led by James Robertson and John Donelson, where the group settled and built Fort Nashborough, which would later become Nashville, Tennessee.

zh.s: 1780年5月13日，256名移民在詹姆斯·罗伯逊和约翰·唐纳尔森带领下，于坎伯兰河畔法兰西利克（又称“大盐泉”）附近的一处猎人和原住民贸易站及营地签署《坎伯兰协定》。他们随后在此定居并修建纳什伯勒堡，那里后来发展为田纳西州纳什维尔。该协定为未来的田纳西州坎伯兰河地区提供民主治理和正式司法制度。

en.s: The naval Battle of Reval or took place on 13 May 1790 (2 May OS) during the Russo-Swedish War (1788-1790), off the port of Reval (now Tallinn, Estonia).

zh.s: 列瓦尔海战于1790年5月13日（儒略历5月2日）发生在俄罗斯—瑞典战争（1788—1790年）期间，地点在列瓦尔港外。列瓦尔即今爱沙尼亚塔林。

en.s: The Battle of Grand-Reng or Battle of Rouvroi (13 May 1794) saw a Republican French army jointly commanded by Louis Charbonnier and Jacques Desjardin attempt to advance across the Sambre River against a combined Habsburg Austrian and Dutch army under Franz Wenzel, Graf von Kaunitz-Rietberg. After winning crossings over the Sambre at Thuin and Lobbes on the 10th and Merbes-le-Château on the 12th, the French were defeated on 13 May at Grand-Reng and forced to retreat.

zh.s: 1794年5月13日的格朗朗战役又称鲁夫鲁瓦战役。路易·沙博尼耶和雅克·德雅尔丹共同指挥的法兰西共和国军队试图渡过桑布尔河，遭遇弗朗茨·文策尔·考尼茨-里特贝格伯爵率领的哈布斯堡奥地利与荷兰联军。法军此前于5月10日在蒂安和洛贝成功渡河，5月12日又在梅贝勒堡渡河，但5月13日在格朗朗被击败并被迫撤退。

en.s: The skirmish at Peltokorpi occurred on 13 May 1808 during the Finnish War, when a Swedish force of 30 men attacked a larger Russian one at Peltokorpi. The Swedes assaulted a smaller guard force first, capturing its underofficer and his horse, before attacking the larger main force, where they managed to kill and wound several. Arvid Adolf Spåre would eventually return to Himango where he was promoted to an officer.

zh.t: 佩尔托科尔皮小规模战斗
zh.s: 1808年5月13日芬兰战争期间，30名瑞典士兵在佩尔托科尔皮袭击一支人数更多的俄军。瑞军先攻击一支规模较小的守卫部队，俘获其下级军官和马匹，随后又袭击俄军主力，并造成数人死伤。阿尔维德·阿道夫·斯帕雷后来返回希曼戈，并获晋升为军官。

en.s: In the Battle of Wörgl or Wörgel on 13 May 1809 a Bavarian force under French Marshal François Joseph Lefebvre attacked an Austrian Empire detachment commanded by Johann Gabriel Chasteler de Courcelles. The Bavarians severely defeated Chasteler's soldiers in series of actions in the Austrian towns of Wörgl, Söll, and Rattenberg. Wörgl is located 20 kilometres (12 mi) south of the modern-day German border on the upper Inn River. The County of Tyrol rose in revolt at the start of the War of the Fifth Coalition. The hardy mountaineers rapidly banded together in irregular units and killed, captured, or routed the area's Bavarian and French garrisons.

zh.s: 沃格尔战役（Wörgel之战）于1809年5月13日发生。弗朗索瓦·约瑟夫·勒费弗尔元帅率领的巴伐利亚军队进攻约翰·加布里埃尔·沙斯特莱·德·库塞勒指挥的奥地利帝国分遣队。巴伐利亚军队在奥地利的沃格尔、瑟尔和拉特滕贝格一系列战斗中重创奥军。沃格尔位于上因河畔，距今德国边境以南20公里（12英里）。第五次反法同盟战争开始时，蒂罗尔伯国爆发起义。当地坚韧的山民迅速组成非正规部队，杀死、俘虏或击溃了该地区的巴伐利亚和法国驻军。

en.s: The Battle of Castel di Sangro was a minor battle in the Neapolitan War that took place on 13 May 1815 in the town of Castel di Sangro in central Italy. The battle resulted in the Neapolitan force being routed. Following defeat at the Battle of Tolentino, the 4th Division of the Neapolitan army, commanded by General Pignatelli Cerchiara had detached from the main army under their king, Joachim Murat, and were retreating south. The commander of the Austrian force, Frederick Bianchi, dispatched his advanced guard, consisting of Hungarian hussars and Tyrolean jägers, in pursuit.

zh.t: 卡斯泰尔迪桑格罗战役
zh.s: 卡斯泰尔迪桑格罗战役是那不勒斯战争中的一场小规模战斗，于1815年5月13日在意大利中部的卡斯泰尔迪桑格罗镇发生。那不勒斯军队被击溃。托伦蒂诺战役战败后，皮尼亚泰利·切尔基亚拉将军指挥的那不勒斯军第四师脱离约阿希姆·缪拉国王率领的主力，向南撤退。奥军指挥官弗雷德里克·比安基派出由匈牙利骠骑兵和蒂罗尔猎兵组成的前卫追击。

en.s: Texas raids on New Mexico in 1843 consisted of two expeditions sanctioned by the still independent country of Texas to raid Mexican commerce on the Santa Fe Trail and to assert control for Texas of New Mexico east of the Rio Grande, long inhabited by Hispanic settlers and Pueblo Indians. Both expeditions failed to do more than create apprehension by both the United States and Mexico that trade would be interrupted on the Santa Fe Trail.

zh.t: 1843年得克萨斯对新墨西哥的袭击
zh.s: 1843年，仍保持独立的得克萨斯共和国批准了两次远征，袭击圣菲小道上的墨西哥商队，并试图控制格兰德河以东的新墨西哥地区；当地长期居住着西班牙裔居民和普韦布洛人。两次远征均未能取得实际成果，只让美国和墨西哥担心圣菲小道上的贸易会中断。

en.t: United States declaration of war on Mexico
en.s: On May 13, 1846, the United States Congress passed An Act providing for the Prosecution of the existing War between the United States and the Republic of Mexico, thereby declaring war against Mexico. The declaration resulted in the Mexican–American War (1846–48). The act laid out regulations for the size and organization of the militia to participate in the war, how they were to be recruited, and the amount of money appropriated for the war—10 million dollars.

zh.s: 1846年5月13日，美国国会通过《授权继续对墨西哥共和国作战法》，由此对墨西哥宣战。这项宣战引发了1846年至1848年的美墨战争。该法规定了参战民兵的规模和编制、招募方式，并拨款1,000万美元用于战争。

en.s: The Battle of Grahovac took place in the eponymous village of Grahovac from 11 to 13 May 1858, when the Montenegrin Grand Duke Mirko Petrović-Njegoš led the army of Principality of Montenegro against the Ottomans, ending in a decisive Montenegrin victory. After the victory, the demarcation of the border between Montenegro and the Ottoman Bosnia Eyalet was finalised.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 格拉霍瓦茨战役于1858年5月11日至13日在同名村庄发生。黑山大公米尔科·彼得罗维奇-涅戈什率领黑山公国军队对抗奥斯曼军队，最终取得决定性胜利。胜利后，黑山与奥斯曼波斯尼亚省之间的边界划定得以完成。

en.s: The 1859 City of Adelaide colonial by-election was held on 13 May 1859 to elect one of six members for City of Adelaide in the South Australian House of Assembly, after sitting member William Henville Burford resigned on 29 April 1859. William Owen won the by-election with 41 per cent of the vote.

zh.s: 1859年5月13日举行殖民地时期的阿德莱德市补选，从南澳大利亚众议院阿德莱德市的6个席位中选出1名议员。原议员威廉·亨维尔·伯福德于1859年4月29日辞职。威廉·欧文以41%的得票率赢得补选。

en.t: The Great Comet of 1861 is discovered by John Tebbutt of Windsor, New South Wales, Australia
en.s: The Great Comet of 1861, formally designated as C/1861 J1 and 1861 II, is a long-period comet that was visible to the naked eye for approximately 3 months. It was categorized as a great comet—one of the eight brightest comets of the 19th century.

zh.t: 1861年大彗星由新南威尔士州温莎的约翰·泰布特发现
zh.s: 1861年大彗星的正式编号为C/1861 J1和1861 II，是一颗长周期彗星，肉眼可见约三个月。它被列为大彗星，是19世纪最明亮的八颗彗星之一。

en.s: The Battle of Kietlanka was a battle of the January Uprising, fought on 13 May 1863, between the insurrect forces against the forces of the Russian Empire. It was fought near the village of Kietlanka, Poland.

zh.s: 基耶特兰卡战役是波兰一月起义期间的一场战斗，于1863年5月13日在波兰基耶特兰卡村附近爆发。起义军与俄罗斯帝国军队交战。

en.s: The Actions near Alexandria (April 24 – May 13, 1864) saw a Confederate States Army force commanded by Major General Richard Taylor surround a greatly superior Union Army led by Major General Nathaniel P. Banks and a United States Navy flotilla commanded by Rear Admiral David Dixon Porter at Alexandria, Louisiana. Porter's gunboats were trapped above the double falls in the Red River by low water.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 亚历山德里亚附近战斗
zh.s: 1864年4月24日至5月13日，理查德·泰勒少将率领的美利坚邦联军在路易斯安那州亚历山德里亚包围了一支人数远多于己方的联邦军队。联邦军由纳撒尼尔·P·班克斯少将指挥，美国海军舰队由海军少将戴维·迪克森·波特指挥。由于水位过低，波特的炮艇被困在红河双瀑布上游。
zh.n: 本条记录采用资料框中给出的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Kansala or Turban Keloo (Mandinka for Annihilation War) was the siege of the capital of the Kaabu federation in 1867 by the Imamate of Futa Jallon, allied with rebellious Fula people from Kaabu itself. The battle, which saw the town completely destroyed, ended Mandinka hegemony over Africa’s Atlantic coast begun by the Mali Empire.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 坎萨拉战役又称“图尔班·凯卢”（曼丁卡语，意为“歼灭之战”），是1867年富塔贾隆伊玛目国及考阿布联邦当地反叛富拉人围攻考阿布首都的一场战役。城镇在战斗中被彻底摧毁。此役结束了自马里帝国时期开始的曼丁卡人在非洲大西洋沿岸的霸权。

en.s: The First Battle of Sidi Abu Urqub took place between the Senussi's and Italy on May 13, 1915. en.s: The action of 13 May 1942 was a naval engagement during World War II between the British Royal Navy and the German Kriegsmarine. en.s: The 1950 British Grand Prix was a Formula One motor race held on 13 May 1950 at the Silverstone Circuit in Silverstone, England. It was the first World Championship Formula One race in the modern era, as well as the fifth British Grand Prix, and the third to be held at Silverstone after motor racing resumed after World War II. It was the first round of the 1950 World Drivers' Championship and the fifth race of the season. The 70-lap race was won by Giuseppe Farina for the Alfa Romeo team, after starting from pole position, with a race time of 2:13:23.6 and an average speed of 146.378 km/h.

en.s: General elections were held in Malaysia on Saturday, 10 May 1969, although polling in Sabah and Sarawak was postponed until between 6 June and 4 July 1970. This was the first parliamentary election in Sabah and Sarawak since the formation of Malaysia in 1963. The ruling Alliance Party, consisting of the United Malays National Organisation (UMNO), the Malayan Chinese Association (MCA) and the Malayan Indian Congress (MIC), retained power but with a reduced majority.

en.s: The 13 May incident was a period of violent racial conflict that erupted in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, on 13 May 1969, following that year's general election. The clashes primarily involved the Malay and Chinese communities and were caused by political and ethnic tensions after opposition parties such as the Democratic Action Party (DAP) and Gerakan made substantial electoral gains in the election, challenging the ruling Alliance Party's dominance.

en.s: The Battle at Springmartin was a series of gun battles in Belfast, Northern Ireland on 13–14 May 1972. It involved the British Army, the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA), and the Ulster Volunteer Force (UVF). The violence began when a car bomb, planted by Ulster loyalists mainly the widely known ballysillan bear, exploded outside a crowded public house in the mainly Irish nationalist and Catholic district of Ballymurphy. UVF snipers then opened fire on the survivors from an abandoned high-rise flat. This began the worst fighting in Northern Ireland since the suspension of the Parliament of Northern Ireland and the imposition of direct rule from London.

zh.s: 1972年5月13日至14日，北爱尔兰贝尔法斯特发生一系列枪战，史称斯普林马丁战役。交战方包括英国陆军、临时爱尔兰共和军（IRA）和阿尔斯特志愿军（UVF）。暴力事件始于一枚汽车炸弹在巴利墨菲区一家拥挤酒吧外爆炸；该区以爱尔兰民族主义者和天主教徒为主。炸弹由阿尔斯特效忠派安放，主要是广为人知的“巴利西兰熊”。随后，UVF狙击手从一栋废弃高层住宅向幸存者开火。此后，北爱尔兰爆发了自北爱尔兰议会暂停运作并由伦敦实施直接统治以来最严重的战斗。

en.s: The Sennichi Department Store Building fire occurred in Sennichimae, Minami-ku (now Chuo-ku), Osaka, Japan on May 13, 1972. The fire killed 118 people and injured another 78. Damage was estimated at $50,000,000, which included $1,800,000 in vehicle damage.

en.t: Attempted assassination of Pope John Paul II
en.s: On 13 May 1981, in St. Peter's Square in Vatican City, Pope John Paul II was shot and wounded by Mehmet Ali Ağca while he was entering the square. The Pope was struck twice and suffered severe blood loss. Ağca was apprehended immediately and later sentenced to life in prison by an Italian court. The Pope forgave Ağca for the assassination attempt.

zh.t: 约翰·保罗二世遇刺未遂
zh.s: 1981年5月13日，教皇约翰·保罗二世进入梵蒂冈圣彼得广场时，遭穆罕默德·阿里·阿加枪击受伤。教皇中弹两次，失血严重。阿加当场被捕，后来被意大利法院判处终身监禁。教皇原谅了阿加的刺杀行为。

en.s: The 1981 European Cup Winners' Cup Final was a football match contested on 13 May 1981 between Dinamo Tbilisi of the Soviet Union and Carl Zeiss Jena of East Germany. It was the final game of the 1980–81 European Cup Winners' Cup, and the 21st European Cup Winners' Cup final, held at Rheinstadion in Düsseldorf, West Germany. Only 4,750 people attended the match, though some sources claim there were 9,000 people.

zh.s: 1981年欧洲优胜者杯决赛于1981年5月13日举行，对阵双方是苏联第比利斯迪纳摩队和东德卡尔蔡司耶拿队。这是1980—81赛季欧洲优胜者杯的最后一场比赛，也是该项赛事的第21场决赛，比赛在西德杜塞尔多夫的莱茵体育场举行。现场观众仅4,750人，但有些来源称观众人数为9,000人。

en.s: The 34th Cannes Film Festival was held from 13 to 27 May 1981. French filmmaker Jacques Deray served as jury president for the main competition. Polish filmmaker Andrzej Wajda won the Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, for the film Man of Iron. The festival opened with Three Brothers by Francesco Rosi, and closed with Honeysuckle Rose by Jerry Schatzberg.

zh.s: 第34届戛纳电影节于1981年5月13日至27日举行。法国导演雅克·德雷担任主竞赛单元评审团主席。波兰导演安杰伊·瓦伊达凭电影《铁人》获得最高奖项金棕榈奖。电影节以弗朗切斯科·罗西执导的《三兄弟》开幕，以杰里·沙茨伯格执导的《忍冬玫瑰》闭幕。

en.s: The 1985 MOVE bombing, locally known by its date, May 13, 1985, was the aerial bombing of a house, and the destruction of 61 more houses by the subsequent fire, in the Cobbs Creek neighborhood of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States, by the Philadelphia Police Department during an armed battle with MOVE, a terrorist-designated black liberation organization.

zh.s: 1985年MOVE组织爆炸案发生于1985年5月13日，费城当地也以该日期称呼此事。费城警察局在与MOVE组织发生武装冲突期间，从空中轰炸了宾夕法尼亚州费城科布斯溪社区的一栋房屋。随后发生的火灾又烧毁61栋房屋。MOVE是一个被列为恐怖组织的黑人解放组织。

en.s: The 1985 Yukon general election was held on May 13, 1985 to elect members of the 26th Legislative Assembly of the territory of Yukon, Canada. It was the first Yukon general election with live results coverage on television, and was suspenseful as telecommunications problems prevented the results of the Old Crow riding from being known outside of that community. It was won by the New Democratic Party.

zh.s: 加拿大育空地区于1985年5月13日举行大选，选出该地区第26届立法议会议员。这是育空地区首次通过电视直播选举结果。由于电信故障，老克罗选区的结果一度无法传到当地以外，选情因此颇为紧张。最终由新民主党获胜。

en.s: The Italian regional elections of 1985 were held on 12 and 13 May. The fifteen ordinary regions, created in 1970, elected their fourth assemblies.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1985年意大利大区选举于5月12日至13日举行。15个普通大区选出了各自的第四届大区议会；这些大区于1970年设立。
zh.n: 本条记录采用资料框中给出的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1987 Bulgarian Cup final was the 47th final of the Bulgarian Cup, and was contested between CSKA Sofia and Levski Sofia on 13 May 1987 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. CSKA won the final 2–1.

zh.s: 1987年保加利亚杯决赛是该赛事的第47场决赛，于1987年5月13日在索菲亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行，对阵双方为索菲亚中央陆军队和索菲亚列夫斯基队。中央陆军队以2比1获胜。

en.s: The 1987 European Cup Winners' Cup Final was a football match contested between Ajax of Netherlands and 1. FC Lokomotive Leipzig of East Germany. It was the final match of the 1986–87 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 27th European Cup Winners' Cup final. The final was held at Olympic Stadium in Athens, Greece. Ajax won the match 1–0 with a 20th-minute header from Marco van Basten.

zh.s: 1987年欧洲优胜者杯决赛由荷兰阿贾克斯队对阵东德莱比锡火车头队。这是1986—87赛季赛事的最后一场比赛，也是该项赛事的第27场决赛。比赛在希腊雅典奥林匹克体育场举行。阿贾克斯凭马尔科·范巴斯滕第20分钟的头球，以1比0获胜。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Iran on 8 April 1988, with a second round on 13 May. The result was a victory for leftist politicians who later emerged as reformists. The number of clerics elected to the Majlis was reduced by over a third.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 伊朗于1988年4月8日举行议会选举，并于5月13日举行第二轮投票。左翼政治人物在选举中获胜，他们后来成为改革派。进入伊朗伊斯兰议会议员席位的教士人数减少了三分之一以上。
zh.n: 本条记录采用资料框中列出的事件日期。

en.s: The 1989 Tasmanian state election was held on 13 May 1989 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 35 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — seven members were elected from each of five electorates. The quota required for election was 12.5% in each division. The incumbent Liberal government headed by Robin Gray hoped to secure a third term in office.

zh.s: 澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州于1989年5月13日举行选举，选出州众议院的35名议员。选举采用黑尔—克拉克比例代表制，5个选区各选出7名议员，每个选区的当选门槛为12.5%。由罗宾·格雷领导的自由党现任政府希望赢得第三个任期。

loc: 德国北莱茵-威斯特法伦州

en.s: The North Rhine-Westphalia state election, 1990 took place on May 13, 1990 to elect the 239 members of the Landtag (state legislature). It resulted in clearly confirming the state government led by Johannes Rau, providing the SPD with an absolute majority of seats for the third time after 1980 and 1985.

zh.t: 1990年北莱茵-威斯特法伦州选举
zh.s: 北莱茵-威斯特法伦州于1990年5月13日举行选举，选出州议会的239名议员。约翰内斯·劳领导的州政府获得明确支持，社会民主党（SPD）继1980年和1985年之后，第三次赢得议会绝对多数席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1990 Lower Saxony state election was held on 13 May 1990 to elect the members of the 12th Landtag of Lower Saxony. The incumbent coalition government of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) and Free Democratic Party (FDP) led by Minister-President Ernst Albrecht was defeated. The Social Democratic Party (SPD) subsequently formed a coalition with The Greens, and SPD leader Gerhard Schröder was elected Minister-President.

zh.s: 1990年5月13日，下萨克森州举行选举，选出第12届州议会议员。基民盟（CDU）和自民党（FDP）组成、由恩斯特·阿尔布雷希特领导的现任联合政府落败。社会民主党随后与绿党组成联合政府，社民党领袖格哈德·施罗德当选州长。

en.s: The 46th Cannes Film Festival was held on May 13–24, 1993. The Palme d'Or went to Farewell My Concubine by Chen Kaige and The Piano by Jane Campion. The festival opened with My Favorite Season, directed by André Téchiné and closed with Toxic Affair, directed by Philomène Esposito.

zh.s: 第46届戛纳电影节于1993年5月13日至24日举行。陈凯歌执导的《霸王别姬》和简·坎皮恩执导的《钢琴课》共同获得金棕榈奖。电影节以安德烈·泰希内执导的《我的季节》开幕，以菲洛梅娜·埃斯波西托执导的《危险的交易》闭幕。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1995 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Parc des Princes, Paris on May 13, 1995. Paris SG defeated RC Strasbourg 1-0 on a goal by Paul Le Guen.

zh.s: 1995年法国杯决赛于1995年5月13日在巴黎王子公园球场举行。巴黎圣日耳曼凭保罗·勒冈打入的一球，以1比0击败斯特拉斯堡竞赛俱乐部。

en.s: Legislative Assembly elections were held in the Indian state of West Bengal in 1996. The election took place simultaneously with the 1996 Indian general election. This was the last election Jyoti Basu contested, as he retired from politics in 2000.

zh.t: 1996年西孟加拉邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 印度西孟加拉邦于1996年举行立法议会选举，投票与1996年印度大选同时进行。这是乔蒂·巴苏最后一次参加选举；他于2000年退出政坛。

en.t: 1997 New Mexico's 3rd congressional district special election
en.s: A special election to determine the member of the United States House of Representatives for New Mexico's 3rd congressional district was held on May 13, 1997. Republican Bill Redmond defeated Democrat Eric Serna in a result which flipped this heavily Democratic seat to the Republican column. Redmond replaced Bill Richardson, who resigned from his seat in the House after he was appointed by Bill Clinton to be the United States Ambassador to the United Nations.

zh.t: 1997年新墨西哥州第三国会选区补选
zh.s: 1997年5月13日举行补选，选出美国众议院新墨西哥州第三国会选区的代表。共和党人比尔·雷德蒙击败民主党人埃里克·塞尔纳，令这个民主党占明显优势的选区转由共和党掌控。此前比尔·理查森获比尔·克林顿任命为美国驻联合国大使后，辞去了众议员职务；雷德蒙接替了他。

en.s: The 1997 Omaha mayoral election was held on May 13, 1997. Incumbent Mayor Hal Daub narrowly defeated City Councilwoman Brenda Council to win re-election.

zh.s: 奥马哈于1997年5月13日举行市长选举。时任市长哈尔·道布以微弱优势击败市议员布伦达·康瑟尔，成功连任。

en.s: The 51st Cannes Film Festival was held on May 13–24, 1998. The Palme d'Or went to the Greek film Mia aioniotita kai mia mera by Theo Angelopoulos. The festival opened with Primary Colors, directed by Mike Nichols, and closed with Godzilla, directed by Roland Emmerich. Lulu on the Bridge, directed by Paul Auster, opened the Un Certain Regard section.

zh.s: 第51届戛纳电影节于1998年5月13日至24日举行。希腊导演西奥·安哲罗普洛斯执导的《永恒和一日》获得金棕榈奖。电影节以迈克·尼科尔斯执导的《风起云涌》开幕，以罗兰·艾默里奇执导的《哥斯拉》闭幕。保罗·奥斯特执导的《浮世男女》作为“一种注目”单元的开幕影片放映。

en.s: The 1998 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup final was a football match that took place on 13 May 1998 at Råsunda Stadium in Stockholm, Sweden to determine the winner of the 1997–98 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup. It was contested by Chelsea of England and VfB Stuttgart of Germany and was the 38th final of what was Europe's second largest football competition at the time.

zh.s: 1998年欧洲优胜者杯决赛于1998年5月13日在瑞典斯德哥尔摩的罗松达球场举行，决出1997—98赛季冠军。参赛双方是英格兰的切尔西和德国的斯图加特足球俱乐部。这是当时欧洲第二大俱乐部赛事的第38场决赛。

en.s: The 1998 Bulgarian Cup final was played at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia on 13 May 1998, and was contested between the sides of CSKA Sofia and Levski Sofia. The match was won by Levski Sofia, thus they achieved their 20th national cup.

zh.s: 1998年保加利亚杯决赛于1998年5月13日在索菲亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行，对阵双方为索菲亚中央陆军队和索菲亚列夫斯基队。列夫斯基队获胜，赢得队史第20座国内杯赛冠军。

en.s: The 1999 election of the President of the Italian Republic was held on May 13, 1999. As a second-level, indirect election, only Members of Parliament and regional deputies were entitled to vote. Carlo Azeglio Ciampi was elected head of state of the Italian Republic, a role of representation of national unity and guarantee that Italian politics comply with the Constitution, in the framework of a parliamentary system.

zh.s: 意大利共和国总统选举于1999年5月13日举行。这是一次间接的第二层级选举，只有议会议员和大区议员有权投票。卡洛·阿泽利奥·钱皮当选意大利共和国总统。在议会制下，总统作为国家元首，负责代表国家团结并确保意大利政治遵守宪法。

en.s: On 13 May 1999, NATO aircraft bombed the village of Koriša, Kosovo during the NATO bombing of Yugoslavia. At least 87 civilians were killed and 60 wounded. NATO officials claimed before and after the bombing that the bombing was on a legitimate military target.

zh.s: 1999年5月13日，在北约轰炸南斯拉夫期间，北约飞机轰炸了科索沃村庄科里沙。至少87名平民死亡，60人受伤。北约官员在轰炸前后均声称，目标是合法的军事目标。

en.s: The Enschede fireworks disaster (known in the Netherlands as the Vuurwerkramp meaning "fireworks disaster") was a catastrophic fireworks explosion occurring at the SE Fireworks depot on 13 May 2000 at 13.00 GMT, in the eastern Dutch city of Enschede. The fire led to an enormous explosion which killed 23 people including four firefighters, and injured 947. 400 homes were destroyed and 1500 buildings damaged. The first explosion had a strength in the order of 800 kg TNT equivalence, while the strength of the final explosion was within the range of 4000–5000 kg TNT.

zh.t: 恩斯赫德烟花爆炸灾难
zh.s: 恩斯赫德烟花爆炸灾难（荷兰语称Vuurwerkramp，意为“烟花灾难”）于2000年5月13日格林尼治标准时间13时发生在荷兰东部城市恩斯赫德的SE烟花仓库。火灾引发巨大爆炸，造成23人死亡，其中包括4名消防员，947人受伤。400栋住宅被毁，1,500栋建筑受损。第一次爆炸的威力约相当于800公斤TNT，最后一次爆炸约相当于4,000至5,000公斤TNT。

en.s: The 2000 FA Trophy Final was the 31st final of The Football Association's cup competition for levels 5–8 of the English football league system. It was contested by Kettering Town and Kingstonian on 13 May 2000 at Wembley Stadium, London. Kingstonian won the match 3–2 after recovering from a 2-1 deficit with Eddie Akuamoah scoring twice and Amara Simba scoring the winning goal. .

zh.s: 2000年英格兰足总锦标赛决赛是英格兰足总为英格兰足球联赛体系第5至第8级球队举办的杯赛第31场决赛。2000年5月13日，基特宁镇和金斯顿人队在伦敦温布利球场交锋。金斯顿人以3比2获胜；他们在一度以1比2落后的情况下反超，埃迪·阿夸莫阿梅开二度，阿马拉·辛巴打入制胜球。

en.s: The 2000 Cupa României final was the 62nd final of Romania's most prestigious cup competition. The final was played at the Stadionul Naţional in Bucharest on 13 May 2000 and was contested between Divizia A sides Dinamo București and Universitatea Craiova. The cup was won by Dinamo.

zh.s: 2000年罗马尼亚杯决赛是罗马尼亚最高级别杯赛的第62场决赛。比赛于2000年5月13日在布加勒斯特国家体育场举行，对阵双方是甲级联赛球队布加勒斯特迪纳摩和克拉约瓦大学，迪纳摩最终夺冠。

en.s: The 2000 Benalla state by-election was held on 13 May 2000, to elect a new member of the Victorian Legislative Assembly in the district of Benalla. The by-election was triggered by the resignation on 12 April of Pat McNamara, the sitting member who was Deputy Premier of Victoria until the defeat of the Kennett government at the 1999 state election.

zh.s: 2000年5月13日，维多利亚州贝纳拉选区举行补选，选出新的州立法议会议员。时任议员帕特·麦克纳马拉于4月12日辞职；在1999年州选举中肯尼特政府败选前，他曾任维多利亚州副州长。

en.s: A national general election was held in Italy on 13 May 2001 to elect members of the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate of the Republic. The 14th Parliament of the Italian republic was chosen. The election was won by the centre-right coalition House of Freedoms led by Silvio Berlusconi, defeating Francesco Rutelli, former Mayor of Rome, and Prime Ministerial candidate of the centre-left coalition The Olive Tree, and rising back to power after Berlusconi's first victory, in the 1994 general election.

zh.s: 意大利于2001年5月13日举行全国大选，选出众议院和共和国参议院议员，并组成意大利第14届议会。西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼领导的中右翼“自由之家”联盟获胜，击败前罗马市长、由中左翼“橄榄树”联盟推举的总理候选人弗朗切斯科·鲁泰利。贝卢斯科尼在1994年首次胜选后再次执政。

en.s: Lombardy renewed its delegation to the Italian Senate on May 13, 2001. This election was a part of national Italian general election of 2001 even if, according to the Italian Constitution, every senatorial challenge in each Region is a single and independent race. The election was won by the centre-right coalition called House of Freedoms, as it happened at the national level. The House was a new alliance formed for Lombard regional election of 2000 between political giants Pole of Freedoms and Lega Nord. All provinces gave a majority or a plurality to the new Italian Prime Minister.

zh.t: 2001年意大利伦巴第大区参议院选举
zh.s: 伦巴第大区于2001年5月13日改选派往意大利参议院的代表。这是2001年意大利大选的一部分。根据意大利宪法，各大区的参议院选举都是单独举行、彼此独立的竞选。中右翼“自由之家”联盟在该区获胜，与其在全国大选中的结果一致。“自由之家”是一个新联盟，由2000年伦巴第大区选举中成立的“自由极点”和北方联盟两大政治力量组成。该区所有省份都以多数或相对多数支持新任意大利总理。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: A regional election was held in the Basque Country on 13 May 2001 to elect the 7th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 75 seats in the Parliament were up for election.

zh.s: 巴斯克自治区于2001年5月13日举行议会选举，选出该自治区第七届议会。全部75个席位都进行改选。

en.s: The 2001 FA Trophy Final was the 32nd final of The Football Association's cup competition for levels 5–8 of the English football league system. It was contested by Canvey Island and Forest Green Rovers on 13 May 2001 at Villa Park, Birmingham. Canvey Island won the match 1-0 thanks to a goal from Ben Chenery in a final held away from the old Wembley Stadium as work was beginning on building the new Wembley Stadium.

zh.s: 2001年英格兰足总锦标赛决赛是英格兰足球联赛体系第五至第八级别球队参加的足总赛事第32场决赛。比赛于2001年5月13日在伯明翰维拉公园球场举行，对阵双方为坎维岛和福里斯特绿流浪者。坎维岛凭本·切纳里的进球以1比0获胜。当时老温布利球场已不再承办比赛，新温布利球场的建设工作正在进行。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Milan on 13 May 2001 to elect the Mayor of Milan and the 60 members of the City Council. The incumbent Mayor Gabriele Albertini easily won a second term in office, defeating the centre-left candidate and former trade unionist Sandro Carlo Antoniazzi. The municipal elections occurred on the same day of the national general election which was heavily won by Silvio Berlusconi's House of Freedoms, a circumstance that largely influenced also the local vote.

zh.s: 米兰于2001年5月13日举行市政选举，选出市长和60名市议会议员。时任市长加布里埃莱·阿尔贝蒂尼轻松连任，击败中左翼候选人、前工会人士桑德罗·卡洛·安托尼亚齐。此次市政选举与全国大选同日举行，西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼领导的自由之家联盟在全国大选中大胜，这一情况也很大程度上影响了地方投票。

en.s: The 2001 FAI Cup final was the deciding match of the 2000-01 FAI Cup, the national association football cup of Ireland. Bohemians, who had just won the domestic league, and Longford Town contested the final. Bohemians won the match 1–0 O' Connor scored the only goal of the game in the 61st minute.

zh.s: 2001年爱尔兰足协杯决赛决出了2000—01赛季爱尔兰全国足球杯赛冠军。刚赢得国内联赛冠军的波希米亚人队与朗福德镇队争夺冠军。波希米亚人以1比0获胜，奥康纳在第61分钟打入全场唯一进球。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Rome on 13 and 27 May 2001 to elect the Mayor of Rome and 60 members of the City Council, as well as the nineteen presidents and more than 400 councillors of the 19 municipi in which the municipality was divided. The first round of the elections occurred on the same date of the national general election.

zh.s: 罗马于2001年5月13日和27日举行市政选举，选出市长、60名市议会议员，以及全市19个市辖区的区长和400多名区议员。首轮投票与全国大选在同一天举行。

en.s: The Jacksonville mayoral election of 2003 took place on May 13, 2003. The two candidates were Republican millionaire John Peyton, and former Sheriff of Jacksonville Nat Glover. John Peyton won the election.

zh.s: 2003年5月13日，杰克逊维尔举行市长选举。两名候选人是共和党富商约翰·佩顿和杰克逊维尔前警长纳特·格洛弗。佩顿赢得选举。

en.s: On 13 May 2005, protests erupted in Andijan, Uzbekistan. At one point, troops from the Uzbek National Security Service (SNB) fired into a crowd of protesters. Estimates of those killed on 13 May range from 187, the official count of the government, to several hundred. A defector from the SNB alleged that 1,500 were killed. The bodies of many of those who died were allegedly hidden in mass graves following the massacre.

zh.s: 2005年5月13日，乌兹别克斯坦安集延爆发抗议活动。其间，乌兹别克国家安全局（SNB）的部队向示威人群开火。对5月13日死亡人数的估计，从政府公布的187人到数百人不等。一名从SNB叛逃的人声称有1,500人被杀。大屠杀后，据称许多死者遗体被藏在集体坟墓中。

en.t: 2006 Czech Social Democratic Party leadership election
en.s: The Czech Social Democratic Party (ČSSD) leadership election of 2006 was held on 13 May 2006. Czech Prime Minister and Jiří Paroubek was elected new leader of the party. Paroubek stated that he feels obliged by the result and that he plans to win next legislative election.

zh.t: 2006年捷克社会民主党党魁选举
zh.s: 捷克社会民主党（ČSSD）于2006年5月13日举行党魁选举。捷克总理伊日·帕劳贝克当选该党新任党魁。帕劳贝克表示，自己感到肩负责任，并计划赢得下一次立法选举。

en.s: The 2006 Scottish Cup Final was played on 13 May 2006 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 120th Scottish Cup. The final was contested by Heart of Midlothian (Hearts), who beat Hibernian 4–0 in the semi-final, and Gretna, who beat Dundee 3–0. Hearts had previously reached the final 13 times, winning six.

zh.s: 2006年苏格兰杯决赛于2006年5月13日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，是第120届苏格兰杯的决赛。参赛双方是哈茨和格雷特纳。哈茨在半决赛中以4比0击败希伯尼安，格雷特纳则以3比0击败邓迪。哈茨此前13次进入决赛，赢得其中6次。

en.s: The 2006 Belgian Cup final, took place on 13 May 2006 between Zulte Waregem and Mouscron. It was the 51st Belgian Cup final and was won by Zulte Waregem due to an injury time winner by Tim Matthys.

zh.s: 2006年比利时杯决赛于2006年5月13日在祖尔特瓦雷赫姆队和穆斯克龙队之间举行，是第51场比利时杯决赛。蒂姆·马蒂斯在伤停补时阶段打入制胜球，帮助祖尔特瓦雷赫姆夺冠。

en.s: The 2006 FA Cup final was a football match played between Liverpool and West Ham United on 13 May 2006 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff. It was the final match of the 2005-06 FA Cup, the 125th season of the world's oldest football knockout competition. Liverpool were participating in their 13th final; they had previously won six and lost six.

zh.s: 2006年英格兰足总杯决赛于2006年5月13日在加的夫千禧球场举行，对阵双方为利物浦和西汉姆联。这是2005—06赛季足总杯的最后一场比赛，也是世界上历史最悠久的淘汰制足球赛事的第125个赛季。利物浦第13次闯入决赛，此前曾6次夺冠、6次落败。

en.s: The 2006 Austin mayoral election was held on May 13, 2006, to elect the mayor of Austin, Texas. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Will Wynn.

zh.s: 奥斯汀于2006年5月13日举行市长选举，时任市长威尔·温成功连任。

en.s: The 2007 Sacrifice was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), which took place on May 13, 2007 at the Impact Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the third event under the Sacrifice chronology. Nine matches were featured on the event's card.

zh.s: 2007年《牺牲》是由全面不间断动作摔角联盟（TNA）制作的一场职业摔角付费赛事，于2007年5月13日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的冲击区举行。这是《牺牲》系列赛的第三场赛事，当晚安排了9场比赛。

en.s: The 2007 Bremen state election was held on 13 May 2007 to elect the members of the Bürgerschaft of Bremen, as well as the city councils of Bremen and Bremerhaven. The incumbent government of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and Christian Democratic Union (CDU) retained its majority with losses. However, the SPD chose to form a new government with The Greens. Jens Böhrnsen was re-elected as Mayor.

zh.s: 不来梅州于2007年5月13日举行选举，选出不来梅州议会以及不来梅和不来梅港两市的市议会议员。由社会民主党（SPD）和基督教民主联盟（CDU）组成的现任政府虽然失去部分支持，但仍保住多数席位。社会民主党随后选择与绿党组建新政府。延斯·伯恩森再次当选州长。

en.s: The 2008 Nebraska Republican presidential primary took place on May 13, 2008. John McCain won the primary, although he had secured his party's nomination weeks before the election through his performance in earlier primary contests. The Nebraska primary was non-binding and only indicated Republican voters' preference for president. Nebraska Republicans' State Convention ultimately chose the delegates to the 2008 Republican National Convention, who formally nominated the Republican candidate for the presidency.

zh.t: 2008年内布拉斯加州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年内布拉斯加州共和党总统初选于2008年5月13日举行。约翰·麦凯恩赢得初选，尽管他已凭此前几场初选的表现，在数周前锁定党内提名。内布拉斯加州初选不具约束力，只用于反映共和党选民的总统人选倾向。内布拉斯加州共和党最终由州代表大会选出代表参加2008年共和党全国代表大会，再由全国代表大会正式提名共和党总统候选人。

en.s: The 2008 West Virginia Democratic presidential primary took place on May 13, 2008 with polls closing at 7:30 p.m. EST. It was open to Democrats and Independents. The primary determined 28 delegates to the 2008 Democratic National Convention, who were awarded on a proportional basis. West Virginia's Democratic delegation also included 11 unpledged "superdelegates". The primary came late in the nomination race.

zh.t: 2008年西弗吉尼亚州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年西弗吉尼亚州民主党总统初选于2008年5月13日举行，投票站于美国东部标准时间19时30分关闭。民主党人和独立选民可以参加。初选按比例分配28名代表参加2008年民主党全国代表大会。西弗吉尼亚州民主党代表团中还包括11名不受承诺约束的“超级代表”。这场初选在党内提名竞选的后期举行。

en.s: The 2008 Mississippi 1st congressional district special election was a special election in the state of Mississippi to determine who would serve the remainder of former Representative Roger Wicker's term. After an April 22, 2008 ballot resulted in no candidate receiving a majority, Democratic Party candidate Travis Childers defeated Republican candidate Greg Davis in a runoff election on May 13, 2008.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2008年密西西比州第一国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 2008年密西西比州第一国会选区举行特别选举，选出众议员罗杰·威克剩余任期的继任者。4月22日首轮投票中没有候选人获得多数票，因此于2008年5月13日举行决选。民主党候选人特拉维斯·柴尔德斯击败共和党候选人格雷格·戴维斯。
zh.n: 本条记录采用资料框中列出的事件日期。

en.s: The 2009 Copa del Rey final was the 107th final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey (including two seasons where two rival editions were played). The final was played at Mestalla in Valencia on 13 May 2009. The match was won by FC Barcelona, who beat Athletic Bilbao 4–1. This was the first title of Barcelona that year, before winning La Liga and the UEFA Champions League to earn their first treble.

zh.s: 2009年西班牙国王杯决赛是该赛事的第107场决赛，计入曾有两个对立版本的两个赛季。比赛于2009年5月13日在瓦伦西亚的梅斯塔利亚球场举行。巴塞罗那以4比1击败毕尔巴鄂竞技。此后巴塞罗那还赢得西甲联赛和欧洲冠军联赛，首次实现三冠王；国王杯是球队当年的首个冠军。

en.s: The 2009 Coppa Italia final was the final match of the 2008–09 Coppa Italia, the top cup competition in Italian football. The match was played at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome on 13 May 2009 between Lazio and Sampdoria; Lazio won 6–5 on penalties after the match ended 1–1 after extra time. Hugo Campagnaro missed his spot kick for Sampdoria and allowed Ousmane Dabo to slot home the winner for Lazio.

zh.s: 2009年意大利杯决赛是2008—09赛季该项意大利顶级足球杯赛的最后一场比赛。比赛于2009年5月13日在罗马奥林匹克体育场举行，对阵双方为拉齐奥和桑普多利亚。双方加时赛后以1比1战平，拉齐奥在点球大战中以6比5获胜。桑普多利亚球员雨果·坎帕尼亚罗罚失点球，奥斯曼·达博随后罚进制胜点球，帮助拉齐奥夺冠。

en.s: The 2009 Turkish Cup final was played between Beşiktaş, and Fenerbahçe on 13 May 2009 in İzmir. Beşiktaş won 4–2.

zh.s: 2009年土耳其杯决赛于2009年5月13日在伊兹密尔举行，对阵双方为贝西克塔什和费内巴切。贝西克塔什以4比2获胜。

en.s: The 2009 Ligakupa final decided the winners of the 2008–09 Ligakupa, the 2nd season of Hungarian football league cup, the Ligakupa. The match was played on 13 May 2009 at the Révész Géza utcai Stadion in Siófok between Pécs and Fehérvár. Fehérvár successfully defended their title with a 3–1 victory, securing their second Ligakupa trophy. The club remain, the last team to successfully defend their trophy.

zh.s: 2009年匈牙利联赛杯决赛决出了2008—09赛季冠军，也是该项赛事创办后的第二个赛季。比赛于2009年5月13日在希欧福克的雷维斯·盖萨街体育场举行，对阵双方为佩奇和费赫尔瓦尔。费赫尔瓦尔以3比1获胜，成功卫冕并赢得队史第二座联赛杯。该队至今仍是唯一一支成功卫冕的球队。

en.s: The 2009 Indian general election in Uttarakhand, occurred for 5 seats in the state. All 5 seats were won by the Indian National Congress.

zh.s: 2009年印度大选在北阿坎德邦改选5个席位，印度国民大会党赢得全部5席。

en.s: General elections were held in India in five phases between 16 April 2009 and 13 May 2009 to elect the members of the fifteenth Lok Sabha. With a registered electorate of 716 million and a turnout of 417 million voters, it was the largest democratic election in the world until being surpassed by the 2014 general election.

zh.s: 印度于2009年4月16日至5月13日分五个阶段举行大选，选出第15届人民院议员。登记选民达7.16亿人，其中4.17亿人投票。这是当时全球规模最大的民主选举，直到2014年印度大选才被超过。

en.s: The 2010 Danish Cup final was the final and deciding match of the 2009-10 Danish Cup tournament. It took place on Thursday 13 May 2010 at Parken Stadium in Copenhagen. It was contested between first-time finalists FC Nordsjælland, and FC Midtjylland who had lost their two earlier finals. Nicolai Vollquartz refereed the match in front of a crowd of 18,856.

zh.s: 2010年丹麦杯决赛是2009—10赛季丹麦杯的决胜场，于2010年5月13日（星期四）在哥本哈根帕肯球场举行。首次闯入决赛的北西兰队对阵此前两次进入决赛均告失利的中日德兰队。尼古拉·沃尔夸茨担任主裁判，现场观众为18,856人。

en.s: A double bombing occurred on 13 May 2011 in Shabqadar Fort in Charsadda District of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province of Pakistan. 98 people were killed when two suicide bombs exploded in the Frontier Constabulary training centre. At least 140 others were injured. The explosions occurred while cadets were getting into buses for a ten-day leave after a training course.

zh.s: 2011年5月13日，巴基斯坦开伯尔-普什图省查萨达地区的沙布卡达堡发生两起爆炸。两名自杀式袭击者在边防警察训练中心引爆炸弹，造成98人死亡、至少140人受伤。爆炸发生时，学员刚结束训练课程，正准备乘车休假10天。

en.s: The North Rhine-Westphalia state election, 2012 was a snap election held on 13 May 2012, to elect members to the Landtag of the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia, after the former Landtag was dissolved on 14 March 2012. The red-green minority government led by Minister-President Hannelore Kraft was returned with a 19-seat majority and were able to continue governing the state.

zh.t: 2012年北莱茵-威斯特法伦州选举
zh.s: 北莱茵-威斯特法伦州于2012年5月13日提前举行选举，选出该州州议会成员。此前州议会于2012年3月14日解散。由州长汉内洛蕾·克拉夫特领导的社民党与绿党少数派政府重新获得执政资格，并取得19席多数，得以继续执政。

en.s: The 2011–12 FA Vase final was the 38th final of The Football Association's cup competition for teams at levels 9–11 of the English football league system. The match was contested between Dunston UTS, of the Northern League Division 1 (level 9), and West Auckland Town, of the Northern League Division 1 (level 9).

zh.s: 2011—12赛季英格兰足总花瓶赛决赛是英格兰足总为英格兰足球联赛体系第9至第11级球队举办的杯赛第38场决赛。对阵双方是北方联赛一级球队邓斯顿UTS和西奥克兰镇。

en.s: The Cadereyta Jiménez massacre occurred on the Fed 40 on 12–13 May 2012. Mexican officials stated that 49 people were decapitated and mutilated by members of Los Zetas drug cartel and dumped by a roadside near the city of Cadereyta Jiménez in northern Mexico. The Blog del Narco, a blog that documents events and people of the Mexican drug war anonymously, reported that the actual (unofficial) death toll may be more than 68 people.

zh.t: 卡德雷塔希门内斯屠杀
zh.s: 卡德雷塔希门内斯屠杀发生于2012年5月12日至13日的40号联邦公路附近。墨西哥官员称，泽塔斯贩毒集团成员杀害并肢解了49人，将尸体丢弃在墨西哥北部卡德雷塔希门内斯市附近的路边。匿名记录墨西哥毒品战争事件与人物的博客“毒枭博客”称，实际死亡人数可能超过68人，但这一数字未经官方确认。

en.t: Manchester City F.C. 3–2 Queens Park Rangers F.C.
en.s: On 13 May 2012, Manchester City played Queens Park Rangers (QPR) at the Etihad Stadium in both teams' 38th and final match of the 2011–12 Premier League season. City entered the match in first place on goal difference, being level on 86 points with local rivals Manchester United, and needed to match or better United's result at Sunderland at the Stadium of Light to win the league.

zh.t: 曼彻斯特城3比2战胜女王公园巡游者
zh.s: 2012年5月13日，曼彻斯特城在伊蒂哈德球场迎战女王公园巡游者（QPR），这是两队2011—12赛季英超联赛的第38场、也是最后一场比赛。曼城当时凭净胜球排名榜首，与同城对手曼联同积86分。若想夺冠，曼城至少需要取得与曼联在光明球场对桑德兰的比赛相同或更好的结果。

en.s: The 2013 election to the Senate of the Philippines was the 31st election to the Senate of the Philippines. It was held on Monday, May 13, 2013 to elect 12 of the 24 seats in the Senate. Together with those elected in 2010, the candidates elected in this election shall comprise the 16th Congress. The senators elected in 2010 will serve until June 30, 2016, while the senators elected in this election will serve up to June 30, 2019. The elections to the House of Representatives as well as local elections occurred on the same date.

zh.s: 菲律宾参议院第31次选举于2013年5月13日星期一举行，改选24个席位中的12个。与2010年选出的参议员一起，本次当选者组成第16届国会。2010年当选的参议员任期至2016年6月30日，本次当选者任期至2019年6月30日。众议院选举和地方选举也在同一天举行。

en.t: Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao general election, 2013
en.s: The 2013 general election in the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (ARMM) were held on May 13, 2013. Originally scheduled for October 2011, this was the first ARMM election that was synchronized with the general elections in the Philippines; previously, ARMM elections were held outside the general election day. When the elected officials of the 2008 ARMM elections ended their terms in 2011, President Benigno Aquino III appointed officers-in-charge until the officials elected in 2013 can take their place. The governor and vice governor are elected via first past the post system; they are elected separately and may come from different parties.

zh.t: 2013年棉兰老穆斯林自治区大选
zh.s: 棉兰老穆斯林自治区（ARMM）于2013年5月13日举行大选。选举原定于2011年10月举行；这是ARMM首次与菲律宾全国大选同步举行，此前该自治区的选举都在全国大选日之外进行。2008年ARMM选出的官员于2011年任期届满后，总统贝尼尼奥·阿基诺三世任命临时负责人，直至2013年选出的官员接任。州长和副州长采用简单多数制分别选出，因此两人可以来自不同政党。

en.s: Local elections were held on the Philippines on May 13, 2013, the same day and on the same ballot as national elections. Elected were governors, mayors and council members of Philippine provinces, Philippine cities and Philippine municipalities. Separate elections for barangay officials were held on October. Positions to be elected are mayors, vice mayors, and councilors, and if applicable, governors, vice governors and provincial board members.

zh.s: 菲律宾于2013年5月13日举行地方选举，与全国选举在同一天、同一张选票上进行。选民选出省、市和市镇的省长、市长及议员。描笼涯官员另于10月选举。此次选举的职位包括市长、副市长和市议员；如适用，还包括省长、副省长和省议会议员。

en.s: A general election was held in the Philippines on May 13, 2013. It was a midterm election—the officials elected were sworn in on June 30, 2013, midway through President Benigno Aquino III's term of office. Being elected are 12 senators (half of the Senate), and all 229 district members of the House of Representatives.

zh.s: 菲律宾于2013年5月13日举行大选。这是一次中期选举，当选官员于同年6月30日宣誓就职，任期从贝尼尼奥·阿基诺三世总统任期的中段开始。本次选出12名参议员（占参议院席位的一半）以及众议院全部229名选区代表。

en.s: Local elections were held in Makati on May 13, 2013, within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, the two congressmen, and the sixteen councilors, eight in each of the city's two legislative districts.

zh.s: 马卡蒂于2013年5月13日举行地方选举，与菲律宾大选同步进行。选民选出该市地方职位的官员，包括市长、副市长、两名国会议员，以及16名市议员（两个立法选区各8人）。

en.s: Local elections were held in Imus on May 13, 2013, in conjunction with the 2013 Philippine general election. en.t: 2013 Philippine House of Representatives elections in the Zamboanga Peninsula
en.s: Elections were held in Zamboanga Peninsula for seats in the House of Representatives of the Philippines on May 13, 2013. The candidate with the most votes won that district's seat for the 16th Congress of the Philippines. In Isabela, Basilan, although a part of this region, the voters elect their representative via Basilan's legislative district. Isabela is politically within Basilan despite being in a separate regions.

en.t: American physician Kermit Gosnell is found guilty in Pennsylvania of murdering three infants born alive during attempted abortions, involuntary manslaughter of a woman during an abortion procedure, and other charges
en.s: Kermit Barron Gosnell (February 9, 1941 – March 1, 2026) was an American serial killer and abortion doctor. At his clinic in West Philadelphia, Gosnell provided illegal late-term abortions, committed post-labor infanticide after many live births, and ran a prescription pill mill which eventually attracted federal attention.

en.s: The 2014 Newark mayoral election took place in Newark, the most populous city in New Jersey, USA, on May 13, 2014. The race was characterized as a contest between two candidates, Ras J. Baraka and Shavar Jeffries, both from Newark's South Ward. Elections for all seats on the nine member Municipal Council of Newark also took place. Luis A. Quintana, who had become Mayor of Newark following the resignation of Cory Booker, did not seek the seat. The turnout was 45,071 representing 29.59% of registered voters. Shortly after polls closed, Baraka declared victory in the election, with 22,751 votes to 20,260 votes for Shavar Jeffries.

zh.s: 2014年纽瓦克市长选举于2014年5月13日在美国新泽西州人口最多的城市纽瓦克举行。两名主要候选人是来自纽瓦克南区的拉斯·J·巴拉卡和沙瓦尔·杰弗里斯。纽瓦克九人市政委员会所有席位也在同一天进行选举。因科里·布克辞职而接任市长的路易斯·A·金塔纳没有竞选该职位。投票人数为45,071，占登记选民的29.59%。投票站关闭后不久，巴拉卡宣布获胜；他得到22,751票，杰弗里斯得到20,260票。

en.s: On 13 May 2014, a fire broke out at Eynez coal mine in Soma, Manisa, Turkey, killing 301 workers in the deadliest mining accident in the country's history. The mine was operated by Soma Kömür İşletmeleri A.Ş. under a contract with the state-owned Turkish Coal Operations Authority. There were 787 workers underground when the fire occurred near a shift change.

zh.s: 2014年5月13日，土耳其马尼萨省索马镇的埃伊内兹煤矿发生火灾，造成301名矿工死亡，是土耳其历史上伤亡最严重的矿难。该矿由索马煤矿公司依据与国有土耳其煤炭管理局签订的合同运营。火灾发生时，井下有787名矿工，事故发生在交接班前后。

en.s: The 2017 European Rugby Champions Cup Final was the final match in the 2016–17 European Rugby Champions Cup, and the twenty-second European club rugby final in general. It was contested by defending champions Saracens of England and French side Clermont at Murrayfield Stadium, in Edinburgh, Scotland, on Saturday 13 May 2017. Saracens retained the trophy after claiming a 28–17 victory.

zh.s: 2017年欧洲橄榄球冠军杯决赛是2016—17赛季赛事的最后一场比赛，也是欧洲俱乐部橄榄球赛的第22场决赛。比赛于2017年5月13日（星期六）在苏格兰爱丁堡的默里菲尔德球场举行，对阵双方是英格兰卫冕冠军萨拉森人队和法国克莱蒙队。萨拉森人以28比17获胜，成功卫冕。

en.s: The 2017 Women's FA Cup final was the 47th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the 24th to be played directly under the auspices of the Football Association (FA) and was named the SSE Women's FA Cup Final for sponsorship reasons. The final was contested between Birmingham City Ladies and Manchester City Ladies on 13 May 2017 at Wembley Stadium in London.

zh.s: 2017年英格兰女子足总杯决赛是女子足总杯第47场决赛。该赛事是英格兰女子足球的主要杯赛。这场决赛是英格兰足总直接主办的第24届赛事，因赞助原因名为“SSE女子足总杯决赛”。比赛于2017年5月13日在伦敦温布利球场举行，对阵双方是伯明翰城女足和曼彻斯特城女足。

en.s: The 2019 election of members to the Senate of the Philippines was the 33rd election of members to the Senate of the Philippines for a six-year term. It was held on May 13, 2019. en.t: 2019 San Juan, Metro Manila, local elections
en.s: Local elections was held in San Juan, Metro Manila on May 13, 2019 within the Philippine general election. The voters elected for the elective local posts in the city: the mayor, vice mayor, the congressman, and the councilors, six of them in the two districts of the city. Former Vice Mayor Francis Zamora led the mayoral race with 35,060 votes defeating incumbent Vice Mayor Janella Ejercito, granddaughter of former President and incumbent Mayor of Manila Joseph Estrada, who garnered 24,813 votes.

The following positions were disputed: 81 provincial governorships and vice-governorships 780 Provincial Board (Sangguniang Panlalawigan) members 1,634 mayorships and vice mayorships 13,544 city and municipal councilors (Sangguniang Panlungsod and Sangguniang Bayan) The elective positions in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) were not decided on this day.

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Airdrie and Shotts was held on 13 May 2021 following the resignation of incumbent Scottish National Party (SNP) MP Neil Gray to run for the corresponding seat—which he subsequently won—in the 2021 Scottish Parliament election. zh.t: 2021年艾尔德里和肖茨选区补选
zh.s: 英国艾尔德里和肖茨议会选区于2021年5月13日举行补选。时任苏格兰民族党议员尼尔·格雷辞职，转而竞选2021年苏格兰议会选举中对应的席位，并成功当选，因此产生此次补选。苏格兰民族党候选人阿努姆·盖萨尔-贾维德保住了该席位，虽然多数票减少，但得票占比上升。

en.s: The 2021 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 2020–21 DFB-Pokal, the 78th season of the annual German football cup competition. The match was played on Thursday, 13 May 2021 (on the Feast of the Ascension, a German public holiday) at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. The match was originally scheduled for Saturday, 22 May 2021, but was moved to an earlier date prior to the completion of the league season in Germany.

zh.s: 2021年德国足协杯决赛决出了2020—21赛季德国足协杯冠军，这是该项年度足球赛事的第78个赛季。比赛于2021年5月13日（星期四，即德国公共假日耶稣升天节）在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。原定比赛日期为2021年5月22日（星期六），后来为赶在德国联赛赛季结束前完成赛事而提前。

en.s: The 2021 Danish Cup final was played on 13 May 2021 between SønderjyskE and Randers FC at Ceres Park, Aarhus, a neutral ground. Randers captured their second title in team history in the culmination of the 2020–21 Danish Cup, the 67th season of the Sydbank Pokalen. SønderjyskE appeared in its second consecutive Sydbank Pokalen final, after capturing their first club title of any kind in 2020.

zh.s: 2021年丹麦杯决赛于2021年5月13日在奥胡斯的塞雷斯公园球场举行，对阵双方为桑德捷斯基和兰讷斯，比赛场地为中立场地。兰讷斯赢得队史第二座冠军奖杯，为2020—21赛季丹麦杯（即第67届锡德银行杯）画上句号。桑德捷斯基连续第二年闯入锡德银行杯决赛；该队于2020年赢得队史首个冠军。

en.s: The 2021 Ukrainian Cup final decided the winner of the 2020–21 Ukrainian Cup, the 30th season of the annual Ukrainian football cup competition. en.s: A leadership election was held in May 2022 to determine the successor to Michael Gunner as leader of the Territory Labor Party and Chief Minister of the Northern Territory. Gunner announced his pending resignation on 10 May, following the birth of his second son and announcement of the 2022/23 Northern Territory budget. The leadership was confirmed unopposed; Natasha Fyles was elected as Leader, with Nicole Manison, a member of the right faction, remaining as Deputy Leader. While there was speculation of whether Fyles would run for the leadership position, the caucus remained silent and no candidates formally declared until they met on 13 May 2022 and all fourteen members of the caucus elected Fyles as leader of the Labor party and ultimately Chief Minister of the Northern Territory.

en.s: The Battle of Kharkiv was a military engagement that took place from February to May 2022 in and around the city of Kharkiv in Ukraine, as part of the eastern Ukraine offensive during the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Kharkiv, located just 30 kilometres (19 mi) south of the Russia–Ukraine border and a predominately Russian-speaking city, is the second-largest city in Ukraine and was considered a major target for the Russian military early in the invasion.

en.s: A series of military engagements took place in May 2022, most notably from 5 to 13 May, near Lyman and Sievierodonetsk, on the eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war. Russian forces from the 74th Separate Guards Motor Rifle Brigade of the 41st Combined Arms Army were defeated by tanks of the 30th Mechanized Brigade and artillery of the 17th Tank Brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces as the Russians attempted several crossings over the Donets river near the villages of Dronivka, Bilohorivka, and Serebrianka.

en.s: Local elections were held in Mauritania on 13 May 2023, alongside parliamentary and regional elections. The elections were the first local elections held after the first peaceful transition of power in the country as a result of the 2019 presidential elections, in which Mohamed Ould Ghazouani was elected president after incumbent Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz was not able to run due to the two-term constitutional limit.

zh.s: 毛里塔尼亚于2023年5月13日举行地方选举，同时举行议会和大区选举。这是毛里塔尼亚2019年首次和平政权交接后举行的第一场地方选举。2019年选举中，穆罕默德·乌尔德·加祖瓦尼当选总统；时任总统穆罕默德·乌尔德·阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹因宪法规定最多连任两届，不能再次参选。

en.s: The 2023 National League play-off final (known as the Vanarama National League Promotion Final for sponsorship reasons) was an association football match played on 13 May 2023 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Notts County and Chesterfield. The match determined the second and final team to gain promotion from the National League, the fifth tier of English football, to EFL League Two for the 2023–24 season.

zh.t: 2023年英格兰全国联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2023年英格兰全国联赛升级附加赛决赛因赞助原因又称Vanarama全国联赛升级决赛，是2023年5月13日在伦敦温布利球场举行的一场足球比赛，对阵双方是诺茨郡和切斯特菲尔德。比赛决定哪支球队获得最后一个升级名额，从英格兰第五级别的全国联赛升入英格兰足球乙级联赛，参加2023—24赛季。

en.s: The 2023 Armenian Cup final was the 32nd Armenian Cup Final, and the final match of the 2022–23 Armenian Cup. It was played at the Republican Stadium in Yerevan, Armenia, on 13 May 2023, and contested by Shirak and Urartu, with Urartu winning their fourth title.

en.s: The 2024 Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly election was held in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh on 13 May 2024 for constituting the sixteenth Andhra Pradesh Assembly. They were held alongside the 2024 Indian general election. The election results were declared on 4 June 2024. The political alliance Kutami, led by the Telugu Desam Party (TDP), won the election in a landslide, winning 164 of the 175 seats.

zh.s: 2024年5月13日，印度安得拉邦举行立法议会选举，选出该邦第16届议会。此次选举与2024年印度大选同时举行。结果于2024年6月4日公布。由泰卢固之乡党（TDP）领导的库塔米联盟以压倒性优势获胜，在175个席位中赢得164席。

en.t: 2024 Indian general election in Madhya Pradesh
en.s: The 2024 Indian general election was held in Madhya Pradesh in four phases between 19 April and 13 May 2024 to elect 29 members of the 18th Lok Sabha. The Bharatiya Janata Party clean swept the state, winning all the 29 seats.

zh.s: 2024年印度大选中，中央邦分四轮于4月19日至5月13日举行投票，选出第18届人民院的29名议员。印度人民党包揽该邦全部29个席位。

en.s: By-elections to thirteen state assembly constituencies were held in Uttar Pradesh on 13 May 2024 for four seats and on 20 November 2024 for 9 seats. The results were announced on 4 June for 4 seats and 23 November for the rest of the seats. BJP, the ruling party won 8 out of 13 seats and its ally RLD won 1 seat. The Samajwadi Party won four.

zh.s: 北方邦13个邦议会选区举行补选：4个选区于2024年5月13日投票，另外9个于2024年11月20日投票。前4个席位的结果于6月4日公布，其余席位的结果于11月23日公布。执政的印度人民党赢得13席中的8席，其盟友印度国民洛克党（RLD）赢得1席，社会党赢得4席。

en.t: 2024 Indian general election in Andhra Pradesh
en.s: The 2024 Indian general election was held in Andhra Pradesh on 13 May 2024 to elect 25 members of the 18th Lok Sabha. Legislative assembly elections were held simultaneously with the general election.

zh.s: 2024年印度大选中，安得拉邦于2024年5月13日举行投票，选出第18届人民院的25名议员。立法议会选举也与大选同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 Indian general election was held in Telangana on 13 May 2024 to elect 17 members of the 18th Lok Sabha. Voter turnout of 65.67% has been recorded. The Bharatiya Janata Party and the Indian National Congress performed strongly in the elections, winning 8 seats each. The remaining seat was won by the AIMIM. The Bharat Rashtra Samiti, which had previously won 9 seats, was decimated and failed to win any seat.

zh.t: 2024年印度大选特伦甘纳邦选举
zh.s: 2024年印度大选中，特伦甘纳邦于2024年5月13日举行投票，选出第18届人民院的17名议员。投票率为65.67%。印度人民党和印度国民大会党表现强劲，各赢得8席，剩余1席由全印度穆斯林联盟赢得。此前赢得9席的印度民族大会党全军覆没，未获任何席位。

en.t: 2025 Massachusetts House of Representatives Essex 6 special election
en.s: A special election in the U.S. state of Massachusetts was held on May 13, 2025, to elect a new member for the 6th Essex district in the Massachusetts House of Representatives, representing the town of Beverly and a portion of Wenham in Essex County. The election filled vacancy caused by the resignation of Democratic state representative Jerry Parisella upon his appointment to a judgeship.

zh.t: 2025年马萨诸塞州众议院埃塞克斯第六选区特别选举
zh.s: 美国马萨诸塞州于2025年5月13日举行特别选举，为马萨诸塞州众议院埃塞克斯县第六选区选出新议员。该选区包括贝弗利镇和温纳姆镇的一部分。原民主党州众议员杰里·帕里塞拉获任法官后辞职，因此举行此次选举。

en.s: The 2025 Omaha mayoral election was held on May 13, 2025, to elect the mayor of Omaha, Nebraska. A primary election was held on April 1, in which the two highest-placing candidates advanced to the general election on May 13. Municipal elections in Omaha are officially nonpartisan. Incumbent Republican mayor Jean Stothert ran for re-election to what would have been a record fourth term in office, but was defeated by Democrat John Ewing.

zh.s: 奥马哈于2025年5月13日举行市长选举。初选于4月1日举行，得票最高的两名候选人进入5月13日的大选。奥马哈市政选举在形式上不按党派划分。共和党籍现任市长让·斯托瑟特竞选连任；若当选，这将是她创纪录的第四个任期，但她最终败给民主党人约翰·尤因。

en.t: 2025 Liberal Party of Australia leadership election
en.s: A leadership election was held on 13 May 2025 to elect the leader of the Liberal Party of Australia, and by virtue, the leader of the Opposition. The election took place after Peter Dutton lost his seat of Dickson at the 2025 federal election. The ballot was won by then-deputy leader Sussan Ley, who became the first female leader of the Liberal Party.

zh.t: 2025年澳大利亚自由党党魁选举
zh.s: 澳大利亚自由党于2025年5月13日举行党魁选举，并由此选出反对党领袖。彼得·达顿在2025年联邦大选中失去迪克森选区席位后，党内举行此次选举。时任副党魁苏珊·莱伊胜出，成为自由党首位女性党魁。
